CDS Protocol B - Bath

Protocol cds protocol wellness

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Transdermal CDS bath protocol for acute support and skin-related conditions. CDS added to bath water for absorption through the skin. Intended for those who cannot or do not want to ingest CDS orally. Effective for localized symptoms and overall detoxification through the skin's surface.

Indications

  • Acute symptoms requiring rapid intervention
  • Skin conditions (eczema, psoriasis, dermatitis)
  • Localized pain and inflammation
  • Musculoskeletal complaints
  • General detoxification through transdermal absorption

Steps

  1. Fill a bathtub with warm water (approx. 40-50 gallons / 150-190 liters)
  2. Add 1 cup of CDS to the bath water
  3. Mix well to distribute CDS throughout the water
  4. Soak for 20-30 minutes
  5. Breathe normally - avoid concentrating inhalation of gases rising from bath water
  6. Shower off after bath to rinse residual CDS

Dosage

CDS bath protocol: 1 cup CDS per full bathtub of warm water (approx. 40-50 gallons)

Expected Outcomes

  • Rapid reduction of acute symptoms
  • Improved skin condition
  • Reduced localized inflammation
  • Enhanced transdermal detoxification

Monitoring

  • Monitor skin for irritation or redness
  • Stay hydrated before and after bath
  • Reduce soak time if skin sensitivity occurs
  • Avoid inhaling concentrated vapors from bath water

Frequency: Once per bath (20-30 minutes soak)
